review.official:
Dur-nar was once a lieutenant in
Columbia's
standing army. For unknown reasons, she was discharged from military service and through regular recruitment channels, she joined
Rhodes Island
. She has serves as a drill instructor and defensive operator. She excels at using a specially-constructed shield for protection and at finding opportunities to strike enemies with her electric blade.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there are no other signs of infection. At this time, this operator can be confirmed to be uninfected.

[Somatic Cell-Originium Fusion Rate] 0%
Physical exam shows no signs of Oripathy infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.16u/L
Patient has extensive combat experience and bears scars of injuries from Originium. However, there is currently no sign of infection. Periodic examination is recommended.

The upright and candid former soldier is now responsible for mid-level standard courses at Rhodes Island and is also an instructor for introductory courses in heavy armor. Dur-nar previously served in Columbia's army, where she saw plenty of combat and gained a reputation as a highly skilled warfighter. She is something of a foodie, finding the greatest joy in life comes from what she puts in her mouth.

Due to the medical unit's (especially Hibiscus) strict management of provisions in addition to Dobermann's strict requirements for newly inducted operators, even if snacks were placed on Rhodes Island shelves, that does not guarantee that new operators would be able to get their hands on them, much less happily scarf down entire bags. Fortunately for everyone, there is Dur-nar. Through her connections in the logistics department, she has organized a snack network that spans the entirety of Rhodes Island. She spares no effort to provide everyone with the most delicious and cheapest snacks. She cannot hope to compete with 'hidden enemies' in a battle of wits and bravery, but her original intention was merely to add some happiness to the lives of those at Rhodes Island, anyway. On this basis, the managers have turned a blind eye to her activities. Besides, Dobermann's favorite food is actually -- (this record has come to an end suddenly and inexplicably)

Dur-nar is acquainted with Frostleaf, and it was clear from their first meeting at Rhodes Island that their memories of each other may not be pleasant. But time heals all wounds, and the two are no longer the warriors crossing swords that they once were. They have agreed to let the past be the past, and hold on tight to the life they had spent their youth chasing. After a period of warming up, and a bit of friction, Frostleaf came forward with a proposal. She invited Dur-nar to join her on a mission; an invitation the latter gladly accepted. Some people might not understand why a loner like Frostleaf would ask for a partner, but Dur-nar knew the reason: only those who are willing to atone for their sins can be trusted to stand together.

Dur-nar was once a most troublesome soldier, a thorn in the side of her commanders: she was an unsurpassed warrior, but would not listen to orders. When the brass had had enough of her stubbornness, they gave her a promotion, sending her to manage a squad of fresh recruits. She trained the kids, with great frustration, and they in turn changed her disposition. In time, she grew to accept the soldiers as her own. For the sake of their training, she traded her dual electric swords for the sword and shield combo she uses today. She put her heart and soul into her men, right up until the point when the brass decided to send them on a suicide mission. Dur-nar was beside herself. She flew into a rage and assaulted a suprior officer. She has been unwilling to discuss the events that followed. According to certain documents we've acquired, she was forcibly discharged. She then went through a period of hopping from security to police to mercenary work for short stints, up until she arrived at Rhodes Island. When the Doctor asked her in private why she had come to join Rhodes Island, she produced a letter. It was a letter of thanks from the few survivors of her squad of trainees. At the end of the letter, the Doctor fixated on a particular sentence, 'If there were a place where the command actually cared about the grunts, would you give it a try?' After that was an address to send her resume to Rhodes Island, along with all the names of the survivors.

'And that's why I'm here.'

'I saw her. If I'm not mistaken, at that time, she was still known as 'Patrick's Spring.' If you mentioned this code name to any of the senior officers, I guarantee you their eyes would light up. She was that famous. You didn't know that? Oh, of course. You're not from Columbia. Have you heard of the Springtime Offensive? Yes, that's right. THAT Springtime Offensive. Both sides were still getting ready for battle. She picked up two electric blades all by herself and went charging at a group of enemies. I've never seen someone with such an outstanding character as that. The enemy never knew what hit them. The rest of our troops followed her lead, and that was that. The enemy was finished. Yes, she's a strong one, all right. She can do anything. She's just not great at obeying discipline. She really gave those old guys a hard time. I still remember the looks on their faces at her award ceremony. It was something to behold. For a period of time, all of Columbia's recruitment materials had her and her alone on them. It's a shame that I never heard much about her after she moved units. Oh man, she's with you guys. How did you manage to recruit her? My companions have been looking for her for a long time. Even after all this time, she probably fetches a huge commission. Oh, it's time to go. Shift's up, I need to withdraw. Come by and talk more the next time you get a chance. It's a date.' 

Source: Excerpt of recorded conversional between personnel member D335 and Headhunter H. Jr.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Aw, c'mon, get someone more literate for this job. I'm a soldier, all I know is following orders. Paperwork's beyond me.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Life is tough enough already. Let's relax with some butter, frosting and jam.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: If Frostleaf wasn't still lugging that big axe around, there's no way I would've recognized her. We fought together before, probably as enemies. Anyway, I'm relieved to see her living the good life at Rhodes Island.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Watch it, Doctor, you can't go touching my weapon. I just replaced the Originium on that thing. It's dangerous when you hold it wrong... Look out! I, I'll take you to Medical...

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Defensive ability is what matters to a Defender. I don't care if it's organic fiber or ceramic padding, as long as it's the state-of-the-art, just buy it!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Stories from my past? Umm… Don't have much to say. I mean, what kind of story could a bad tempered soldier have? All those merits and medals... Hmph, they're nothing in the face of the lives lost.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: The greenies we got in the reserves are pretty good. But they suck at securing amenities. Back in my day, the rookies were way smarter about hiding cookies.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: I talked to Logistics. From now on, they're putting 'Industrial Material' on all our snack packaging. Then, all we need is you to sign off on them for us, Doctor.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, sorry. I was all caught up in reminiscing. I still can't get past certain things. If my old commander was anything like you, maybe... We wouldn't have had to go through that.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Psst, Psst! Want some pop rocks? I got all kinds. I know I got one you'll love.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hard as rock and lethal as lightning! That's me, Dur-nar. Nice to meet you, Doctor.

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Ah, shoot, I'm out of popcorn.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: A promotion? Good, good, do I get paid more too? Awesome!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: The old me only knew how to charge on ahead and fight without stopping. Now, I fight for everybody. Just give your orders, Doctor.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Ready to deploy. Where am I needed?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: I only have one request: Safety first and don't ever forget it.

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: We're off! Remember to stay frosty and keep an eye out.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I never did get used to the stench of war.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes sir!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: In position!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: I'll leave the support to you.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Cover me!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Hold the line!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Don't be an idiot!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Ya ain't gettin' through me!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Stay down!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Ever heard of the Medal of Glory? I feel that's tailor-made for you.

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: No need to clean up the battlefield? Okay, then we're done here.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: The enemy still hasn't gone far. Should we chase them down?

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Take it easy, Doctor. It's not your fault...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Whoa, I bet a fancy interior like this cost a bundle!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Hmph, Who the--

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: You must be drunk to want to hear me sing war songs. Okay, don't you regret it.

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year! I can finally lay my snacks out for everyone to eat with pride! Medical won't be so cruel on today of all days, right? I've been looking forward to this cake forever, *homp*—oooh, it's amazing! Doctor, move that fork quick or all you get is crumbs~

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Good morning!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: As thanks for always getting us off the hook, here's a present I brought in for you. But first, sign here. I guarantee it's all above board—signed? Great! I'll take this down to Dobermann! A permit for building a snack cupboard, signed by the Doctor!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Huh? It's not often I see you at the bar, Doctor. What's wrong, trouble at work? You're a great commander, I don't want you taking any wrong turns any time soon. Come on, I'll order you an 'Iceflame,' and we'll talk over drinks?
